messages:
Anil: Quick sync — noticed another round of delayed usage ingestion last night; looks like several invoices will need corrections. Can we confirm owners and timeline for remediation + communication?  
Elaine: Yep. Root cause still the same pattern: intermittent Kafka consumer lag after schema-change rollouts, plus a retry path that double-counts tokens when partial batches reprocess. I opened BILL-632 yesterday with initial triage notes.  
Mike: I'm picking up the backfill and invoice correction workflow. PR #472 has the backfill script and dry-run mode. Will run a small dry run today and report findings.  
Sara: For customer comms — do we have a standard crediting template or do we mark as "billing adjustment"? Need to know how big the batch is to estimate outreach.  
BillingBot: Backfill job status: last-run=2026-03-22T03:12:09Z, processed=480k tokens, errors=0, backlog=12k tokens.  
Ryan: I'll own the alerting and detection piece (add metrics + alarm on Kafka consumer lag and reprocess-counts). ETA 2 weeks for alert + playbook. Will create a dashboard and add runbook links.  
Elaine: I'll draft the invoice-correction playbook and customer credit rules by next Fri (2026-03-27). Will include roll-forward/backfill steps + sample command set.  
Anil: Please add the playbook to the ops-runbook and mark a canary customer group for manual verification. Mike, can you add a data QA checklist to PR #472?  
Mike: Yes — will add tests and a verification query. Quick verification snippet I run locally:  
```
-- counts of unprocessed vs processed
select source, sum(tokens) as tokens, status from usage_events
where event_time >= '2026-03-01' group by source, status;
```  
Sara: For comms — suggest two tiers: (1) auto-credit < $50, (2) manual review for >= $50. I'll draft templates and sync with Legal.  
Anil: Action list for visibility:  
- BILL-632 (Elaine) — root cause analysis + playbook draft — due 2026-03-27  
- PR #472 (Mike) — backfill script + QA tests — dry-run today, full run after playbook — due 2026-03-24  
- Alerts (Ryan) — detection + dashboard + pager rule — due 2026-04-06  
- Customer comms (Sara) — templates + credit rules — due 2026-03-26  
- Runbook update (Anil) — add canary + rollback steps — due 2026-03-25  
Please react with :thumbsup: if you confirm.  
Mike: :thumbsup:  
Elaine: :thumbsup:  
Sara: :thumbsup:  
Ryan: :thumbsup:  
BillingBot: Note: next scheduled backfill in 6h.  
Anil: Thanks — we'll meet Friday quick sync after Elaine posts the draft.
